content: कामिन् {%a.%} (-नी|{%f.%}) [कम्-णिनि] .²1 Lustful. .²2 Desirous. .²3 Loving, fond. --{%m.%} .²1 A lover, a lustful person (paying particular attention to ladies); त्वया चन्द्रमसा चातिसन्धीयते कामिजनसार्थः <ls>Ś. 3</ls>; त्वां कामिनो मदनदूतिमुदाहरन्ति <ls>V. 4. 11</ls>; <ls>Amaru. 2</ls>; <ls>M. 3. 14</ls>. .²2 A luxurious husband. .²3 The ruddy goose or चक्रवाक bird. .²4 A sparrow. .²5 An epithet of Śiva. .²6 The moon. .²7 A pigeon. .²8 The Supreme Being. .{@-नी@} .²1 A loving, affectionate, or fond woman; <ls>Ms. 8. 112</ls>. .²2 A lovely or beautiful woman; उदयति हि शशाङ्कः कामिनीगण्डपाण्डुः <ls>Mk. 1. 57</ls>; केषां नैषा कथय कविताकामिनी कौतुकाय <ls>P. R. 1. 22</ls>. .²3 A woman (in general); मृगया जहार चतुरेव कामिनी <ls>R. 9. 69</ls>; <ls>Me. 65</ls>; <ls>Ṛs. 1. 28</ls>. .²4 A timid woman. .²5 Spirituous liquor.
